Short introduction to what this tutorial covers.

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()
```

Set `eval: true` in a chunk to run it when the site is rendered.
